sentences.text: FDA's records show fluorouracil is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 52 vials of fluorouracil 50 mg/mL 20 mL with daily use of 2.8 vials, providing 18.3 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 56 vials of the same presentation with daily use of 2.8 vials, providing 20.3 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, whose plant was last inspected and classified VAI on 2023-08-24.
The second option is to buy from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc., supplied from Gland Pharma Limited.
The third option is to buy from Accord Healthcare, Inc., supplied from Intas Pharmaceuticals Ltd, which was last inspected and classified OAI on 2022-12-02.
